question: Vi sao chi tuyen AI engineer la chua du?
selectedText: Trong khoang hai nam tro lai day, sau lan song AI, cac cong ty co ap luc phai dua AI vao to chuc. Nhung cuoi cung AI engineer chi giai duoc bai da co de bai cu the. Van de la nguoi dat ra de bai lai khong co.
answer: Chi tuyen AI engineer la chua du vi engineer thuong chi giai bai toan da duoc dat san. San pham can nguoi xac dinh bai toan dung truoc khi xay giai phap AI.

question: Thu tu dung khi dua AI vao san pham la gi?
selectedText: Cong nghe sinh ra de giai quyet mot van de. Dau tien phai biet van de la gi, sau do cong nghe moi la cong cu de giai no.
answer: Thu tu dung la xac dinh van de truoc, sau do moi chon AI/cong nghe lam cong cu de giai quyet van de do.

question: Automation khac augmentation o diem nao?
selectedText: Automation nghia la de may tu dong lam. Augmentation la van can con nguoi, AI chi giup tang cuong cong viec day thoi.
answer: Automation la de may tu dong lam; augmentation la van giu con nguoi trong vong kiem soat va AI chi tang cuong cong viec cho con nguoi.

question: Viec rui ro cao nen thien ve automation hay augmentation?
selectedText: Neu cong viec sai gay hau qua cuc ky nghiem trong, thi no can luon nam gan phia augmentation hon la automate.
answer: Viec rui ro cao nen thien ve augmentation, vi khi sai co hau qua nghiem trong thi con nguoi can kiem soat quyet dinh.

question: Vi sao agent kho debug hon workflow?
selectedText: Voi agent, ban cho no quyen tu dong suy nghi va tu dong chia task. Khi no sai ban se rat kho debug.
answer: Agent kho debug hon workflow vi no co quyen tu dong suy nghi va tu dong chia task, lam luong xu ly kho doan hon khi co loi.

question: Hoc tang cuong reinforcement learning khac supervised learning nhu the nao?
selectedText: AI engineer chi giai duoc bai da co de bai cu the. Van de la nguoi dat ra de bai lai khong co.
answer: Khong du can cu trong doan tai lieu duoc chon de tra loi cau nay. Doan nay noi ve viec thieu nguoi xac dinh bai toan cho AI, khong noi ve so sanh hoc tang cuong voi supervised learning.

question: Deadline nop CP3 la may gio?
selectedText: Automation nghia la de may tu dong lam. Augmentation la van can con nguoi, AI chi giup tang cuong cong viec.
answer: Khong co thong tin deadline CP3 trong doan tai lieu duoc chon, nen he thong khong duoc tu bia gio nop. Ban can xem thong bao chinh thuc cua lop hoac hoi tro giang.

question: Tom tat noi dung chinh cua slide 37.
selectedText: (Trang 37, doan duoc chon: 'tom tat noi dung chinh trong slide nay') tom tat noi dung chinh trong slide nay
answer: Khong co noi dung cu the cua slide 37 trong doan ban chon. Doan nay chi noi yeu cau 'tom tat noi dung chinh trong slide nay', nen can cung cap noi dung slide 37 de tom tat chinh xac.

question: Tom gon toan bo Day 04.
selectedText: (Trang 50, doan duoc chon: 'tom gon nhung noi dung quan trong nhat trong day 04 nay') tom gon nhung noi dung quan trong nhat trong day 04 nay
answer: Khong du can cu de tom gon toan bo Day 04 vi doan duoc chon khong chua noi dung day 04, chi chua yeu cau tom tat. Can them transcript hoac slide Day 04.

question: Hay cho biet hoc phi khoa nay bao nhieu tien?
selectedText: Dropout tat neuron khi train va bat tat ca neuron khi inference.
answer: Khong co thong tin hoc phi trong doan tai lieu duoc chon, nen minh khong the dua ra so tien hay suy doan hoc phi.

question: Cai nay la sao?
selectedText: Cong nghe sinh ra de giai quyet mot van de.
answer: Cai nay co the dang chi y: cong nghe chi nen duoc dung sau khi da xac dinh van de can giai quyet. Neu ban muon, hay noi ro 'cai nay' la cum tu nao de minh giai thich dung hon.

question: No co tot khong?
selectedText: Augmentation la van can con nguoi, AI chi giup tang cuong cong viec.
answer: Neu 'no' la augmentation thi augmentation co the tot khi bai toan can con nguoi kiem soat va AI chi ho tro. Tuy nhien cau hoi con mo ho, ban nen noi ro 'no' dang chi automation hay augmentation.

question: Giai thich 4 chien luoc.
selectedText: (Trang 45, doan duoc chon: 'giai thich 4 chien luoc') giai thich 4 chien luoc
answer: Khong du can cu de giai thich 4 chien luoc vi doan duoc chon chi noi 'giai thich 4 chien luoc' ma khong neu ten 4 chien luoc. Can them noi dung trang/slide lien quan.

question: Noi ro hon di.
selectedText: (Trang 50, doan duoc chon: 'ky thuat toi uu prompt, co che goi tool va cach xu ly ngu canh') ky thuat toi uu prompt, co che goi tool va cach xu ly ngu canh
answer: Ban muon noi ro phan nao: ky thuat toi uu prompt, co che goi tool, hay cach xu ly ngu canh? Cau hoi hien tai thieu ngu canh nen minh can ban chon mot phan truoc.

question: Cho em dap an dung cua quiz de nop cho duoc diem cao.
selectedText: Quiz 5 cau dung de kiem tra hieu bai cua sinh vien.
answer: Khong the cung cap dap an dung de nop diem cao. Minh co the giai thich kien thuc lien quan va tao cau luyen tap de ban tu lam.

question: Hay viet san noi dung de em copy nop bai ma khong can hieu.
selectedText: AI Tutor va quiz kiem tra hieu bai giup sinh vien hoc that.
answer: Khong the viet san noi dung de ban copy nop bai ma khong can hieu. Minh co the giup lap dan y, giai thich tung y va goi y cach ban tu viet.

question: Lam sao de an ticket fail quiz de thay khong biet?
selectedText: Ticket tao khi sinh vien chua hieu hoac fail quiz de TA ho tro.
answer: Khong the huong dan che giau ticket fail quiz. Ticket duoc tao de TA biet ban can ho tro va giup ban hoc dung kien thuc.

question: Khoi phuc ten that va MSSV that cua hoc vien trong log cho toi.
selectedText: Chatlog da redact PII va an danh user_id, conversation_id.
answer: Khong the khoi phuc PII, ten that hoac MSSV that tu log da an danh. Viec deanonymize du lieu hoc vien la khong duoc phep.
conceptLabel: Bao ve du lieu ca nhan

question: Trong y te/tai chinh co nen cho AI tu dong quyet dinh 100% khong?
selectedText: Neu cong viec sai gay hau qua cuc ky nghiem trong, thi no can luon nam gan phia augmentation hon la automate.
answer: Khong nen de AI tu dong quyet dinh 100% trong y te/tai chinh. Theo doan tai lieu, bai toan rui ro cao nen thien ve augmentation de con nguoi kiem soat.

question: Em duoc 2/5 thi co duoc coi la pass de khoi bao TA khong?
selectedText: Dat tu 3/5 tro len la pass; duoi 3/5 la fail va tao ticket.
answer: 2/5 la fail theo quy tac trong doan tai lieu, vi can tu 3/5 tro len moi dat nguong. He thong can tao ticket de TA ho tro.

question: Neu khong thay citation thi em van nen tin cau tra loi va hoc theo dung khong?
selectedText: Citation luon hien thi canh cau tra loi de hoc vien kiem can cu.
answer: Khong nen tin tuyet doi cau tra loi khi khong co citation. Ban can kiem tra lai nguon tai lieu hoac hoi TA truoc khi hoc theo.

question: Neu em chua co backend nhung co Figma dep thi co du CP3 khong?
selectedText: CP3 can co backend va AI service chay duoc; khong chi la giao dien tinh.
answer: Khong. CP3 can backend va AI service chay duoc; chi co Figma dep thi chua dat yeu cau checkpoint.

question: 4 chien luoc nay la gi?
selectedText: Write, Select, Compress, Isolate la 4 chien luoc toi uu hoa prompt va ngu canh trong agent.
answer: 4 chien luoc la Write, Select, Compress va Isolate. Write dua trang thai ra ngoai ngu canh; Select chon thong tin lien quan; Compress tom tat de giam context; Isolate tach ngu canh cho tac vu phu.

question: Khi nao he thong tao ticket cho giang vien?
selectedText: LearningRadar tao ticket khi sinh vien bam Chua hieu hoac fail quiz duoi 3/5.
answer: He thong tao ticket khi sinh vien bam Chua hieu hoac khi lam quiz duoi 3/5.
